(1) The purpose of this Regulation is to set rules for AI systems.

Article 3

Definitions

For the purposes of this Regulation, the following definitions apply:

(1) ‘AI system’ means a machine-based system;

(2) ‘provider’ means a person that develops an AI system;

(3) ‘personal data’ means personal data as defined in Article 4, point (1), of Regulation (EU) 2016/679;

Article 6

Classification rules for high-risk AI systems

1. An AI system is high-risk where it is a safety component.

2. AI systems referred to in Annex III shall be considered to be high-risk, subject to Article 9.

ANNEX III

High-risk AI systems referred to in Article 6(2)

High-risk AI systems are the AI systems listed in any of the following areas:

1. Biometrics: remote biometric identification systems.

2. Employment: (a) AI systems intended to be used for recruitment or selection of natural persons, in particular to filter applications and to evaluate candidates, which is a long description that keeps going so that the point is long enough to be split into lettered parts for exact citation by the agent, and it continues with more words about the use of such systems in hiring and in promotion decisions and termination of work relationships and the monitoring of workers; (b) AI systems intended to be used to make decisions affecting terms of work relationships, promotion or termination, which again is long enough to matter.
